description: Agent Aviation Records: submit a flight log record with the fleet, maintenance, pilot and duty records it answers to: the flight log with its reference, the operator and the period; each aircraft the fleet record lists with its id, tail number and type; each pilot record with its id, reference and name; each maintenance record entry with its id, reference, tail number, the airframe total hours it records and the moment recorded; each duty period with its id, reference, pilot and the moments it starts and ends; each flight log entry with its id, reference, tail number, pilot, departure and arrival points, the moment flown and the flight hours logged. The signed report gives the flight log and the records behind it, each flight’s aircraft against the fleet record, the hours each aircraft logs between two airframe totals against the hours those totals move, each flight’s pilot against the pilot records, and each entry against the fields the record format requires, and counts them, and names divergent flight log records: a flight logged on an aircraft the fleet record does not list, flight hours in the log that the maintenance record’s totals do not reflect, a flight with no pilot record behind it, and a log entry missing the fields the record format requires; then a flight outside every duty period on record for its pilot and an aircraft that logs flights with no airframe total in the maintenance record, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No flight log entries, no fleet record beside flights that name an aircraft, no maintenance totals beside logged hours, or no pilot records beside flights that name a pilot leaves those points unverified. Tail numbers match by letters and digits, so N512WL and N-512WL are one aircraft, pilots match by record reference or name, a flight counts between two airframe totals when it is dated after the earlier and on or before the later, and hours read to the tenth. This reads the flight log as a whole against the fleet, maintenance, pilot and duty records behind every flight it holds. Verdict aviation_flight_log_divergent, aviation_flight_log_partial, aviation_flight_log_unverified or aviation_flight_log_consistent. POST /api/aviation-flight-log-check. Reads the aviation records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it flies no aircraft, inspects no aircraft in person, contacts no regulator, examiner or maintenance provider and issues no certification, which stay with the operator, its pilots, its mechanics and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Aviation Records reads an air operator’s own records: flight log records, aircraft maintenance records, airworthiness and directive records, inspection records, pilot certificate records, training and currency records, flight duty and rest records and incident report records, each against the fleet, maintenance, pilot and duty records, the mechanic, certificate and part records, the flight log and the maintenance record, the aircraft, operations and dates flown, the schedule and the corrective entries, the required events and the currency records, the operator’s own limits, or the follow-up entries on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the aircraft and the crew: what the flight log shows, what the maintenance record supports, what the certificates cover, and whether the duty and incident records hold up; it reads records about aircraft and crews, not live flight tracking and not travel booking: the Agent Travel family reads the bookings behind a trip, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records and the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file, while this family reads an air operator’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-aviation-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-aviation-records/.
